answer_1.quote: We create a unified simulation framework with two distinct modes for simulating human interaction with LLMs: SCRIPT mode and AGENTS mode.

answer_2.quote: we use the goal completion score (ranging from 0 to 10, higher scores indicate the agents achieve their social goals better) as the main metric ... We additionally measure the average length of each turn in the dialogues from the two modes as a coarse-grained proxy of the verbosity of the generated dialogues.

answer_3.quote: For evaluation, we use GPT-4 to automatically assess the goal completion rate, which prior work showed had high correlation with human evaluations in Sotopia

answer_4.quote: we ask a set of human evaluators to choose the more natural dialogue given a pair of a SCRIPT and a AGENTS interaction.
